candidates.description: Take a rock from the north quarry. The quarry holds several; each is spent when taken, and when they are gone there is no more stone.
Down tools and go back to idle, so the crew can dig again.

jev.instructions: You are a quarry crew. Stone is finite: every rock you take is gone, and nothing anywhere records how many are left -- you find out by whether there is still one to take. rock/2 is graded ore/rich; the others are not.
